The reference does not describe a grip portion lined with sound-damping material.
The reference does not describe a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
The reference does not describe a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.
This reference describes a Bernoulli gripper for wafers, not a grip unit with an elongated grip portion between first and second housing portions with an air outlet on the second housing portion.
This reference does not describe an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw arranged upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion.
This reference does not describe bent or curved air baffles arranged downstream of a grip portion to guide exhaust air to an air outlet.
